Intensitatea curentului este proporționa: Current is directly proportional to voltage and inversely proportional to resistance: I = U/R. The other forms (U = RI, R = U/I) are equivalent, but only the second option has the correct form.
Prin definiție, 1 Ω = 1 V / 1 A. Conduct: By definition, 1 Ω = 1 V / 1 A. The conductor carries 1 A when 1 V is applied across its ends.
Proporționalitatea I ∝ U dă o dreaptă pr: The proportionality I ∝ U gives a straight line through the origin. Its slope is 1/R, so a higher resistance means a shallower line.
Ampermetrul trebuie străbătut de curentu: The current being measured must flow through the ammeter, so it is connected in series. Its internal resistance is small so it does not alter the circuit.
Curentul depinde de suma rezistențelor:: Current depends on the sum of the resistances: I = E/(R + r). Internal resistance r limits the current, however small R becomes.
U = E − r·I: dependența este liniară, cu: U = E − r·I: the relationship is linear, with slope −r. At short circuit, U = 0 and I = E/r.
Când R = 0, I_sc = E/r. Cu cât r este ma: When R = 0, I_sc = E/r. The smaller r is, the greater the short-circuit current — which is why batteries can be dangerous.
P_u = E²R/(R+r)² are maxim la R = r, cu: P_u = E²R/(R+r)² is greatest at R = r, with a value of E²/(4r). Efficiency is then only 50%, so power matching does not mean high efficiency.
Voltmetrul măsoară și căderea pe amperme: The voltmeter also measures the voltage drop across the ammeter, so U/I = R + R_A. The value is overestimated and corrected using R = U/I − R_A.
